_artifact: PG-P0 revocations registry - external revocation state for VERIFY-P0-01 (--revocations).
_status: MAKER-PREPARED SCAFFOLD. NOT AUTHORITATIVE. An empty revocation list here is NOT a maker attestation that nothing is revoked.
_why_not_authoritative: A maker agent cannot know, and has no authority to assert, the revocation state of a human's signing key. Emptiness here means only 'this maker recorded no revocation', never 'the operator confirms none exists'. Treating a maker-authored empty list as proof of non-revocation would let an agent silently vouch for key validity it cannot observe - the same class of error as a maker self-certifying its own work. A prior candidate (rejected as 2134ea2d53f78b79522b476e78f4b33022595615, REJECT_EXACT_SHA) presented this file as settled state; this file is the corrected form.
_required_before_reliance: The human operator must attest, at signing time, that the revocation state below is complete and current for keyid operator-pgp0-completion-1 and decision PG-P0-CLOSURE-001. Until that attestation exists, any VERIFY-P0-01 run using this file proves only 'not revoked according to an unattested list'.
_schema_note: Matches tools/verify_phase_transition.py's _authority_identity() lookup exactly: revocations.get('revoked_keyids', []) and revocations.get('revoked_decision_ids', []). Append-only: a future revocation is added here and cited by a durable evidence record naming the reason and the authorizing actor.
